summary.text: Regina English is a Democrat who represents District 17 (El Paso County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 9, 2023; Ballotpedia lists her as running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, English served on the Harrison School District Two board from 2019 to 2023.

It also says she earned a bachelor's degree in management, a master's in public administration and a doctorate in organizational leadership from the University of Phoenix, and has worked as a motivational speaker and life coach.
